derived_files.derivation: single 128x128 32-bpp frame extracted and Lanczos-upscaled to 256x256 RGBA PNG (Python PIL); see crates/d4lc-app/assets/ICON_README.md
the upstream file carries an AVIF payload behind a .png name, which the Slint image decoder rejects; decoded and re-encoded as a 33x33 RGBA PNG (Python PIL)

notes: Copied file provenance is synchronized from assets/provenance/asset-manifest.json.

derived_files records converted upstream assets (e.g. the bundled app icon) whose destination bytes intentionally differ from the source, so they stay out of copied_files and the upstream-asset-parity gate; d4lc-cli upstream-provenance --write regenerates copied_files/notes only and does not preserve this section.
